title: Compliance intake smart-sampler and negotiation playbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers frequently submit long, partially-complete security/compliance questionnaires (DPAs, SOC2 evidence lists, vendor RFIs). Each submission generates a multi-day human triage, duplicated evidence assembly, and iterative negotiation with legal. This slows onboarding, increases SE time-to-value, and creates backlog for the Security/Legal teams.

Objective: Build a centralized intake "smart-sampler" and playbook that: captures minimal required signals up-front, returns a pre-populated evidence bundle for common asks, surfaces high-risk clauses that require legal negotiation, and provides a templated SLA negotiation script for Sales/AMs. The feature should reduce manual triage time by >=60% for tiered accounts and accelerate contract close for hosting-sensitive customers.

Scope: Frontend intake form + routing rules in Console; server-side sampler service to map questionnaire items to existing evidence artifacts and previous answers; negotiation playbook templates for common DPA exceptions and jurisdictional clauses; integration hooks to upload assembled evidence to Drive/Confluence and to open a Legal intake (PM ticketing) automatically. Excludes automated legal sign-off and any changes to contract language without Legal approval.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form captures account sensitivity (data residency), hosting mode, and preflight checklist with >=85% coverage for standard vendor questionnaires
Sampler returns a candidate evidence bundle (PDF/zip) containing mapped artifacts for >=70% of questionnaire lines for SOC2/DPA templates
System flags and tags >=95% of high-risk clauses (data export restrictions, subprocessor rules, encryption-at-rest exceptions) for Legal review
Playbook provides Sales with 3 templated negotiation responses per common exception and a severity-based SLA suggestion
End-to-end flow creates an evidence bundle and files a Legal intake ticket automatically with correct attachments and account context
implementation_steps: Design intake UI prototype and minimal required fields with Design (DES review) — 1 week
Define mapping rules between questionnaire taxonomy and our artifact catalog with Security/Legal — 1.5 weeks
Build sampler microservice that matches items to artifacts with confidence score; store mapping in single-table format — 2 sprints
Add routing rules into Console: route high-risk items to Legal, medium to SEs, low to automated response — 1 sprint
Author negotiation playbook templates in partnership with Legal and Sales Ops; ship as templated responses accessible from Console — 2 weeks
Pilot with 3 existing enterprise accounts (Sales-led) and measure triage time and closure delta — 4 weeks
Iterate on mapping rules and confidence thresholds based on pilot feedback
notes: 2026-02-20 kickoff: Align on taxonomy (DPA clauses, SOC2 controls, HIPAA flags). Legal emphasized no automatic clause acceptance — all flagged exceptions must open a Legal intake. Security requested encryption/residency signal be mandatory for hosting-mode accounts. Design suggested progressive disclosure for the intake form to avoid scaring smaller accounts. Agreed pilot accounts must include at least one EU data-residency sensitive customer.
